task: Deliver a tiny Python CLI `todo` (add <text>, list, done <id>; JSON-file persistence) via spec -> tests -> implementation -> review.

workers.goal: Write SPEC.md fully specifying the `todo` CLI: `add <text>`, `list`, `done <id>` subcommands; JSON-file persistence format (field names, types, id assignment rule, file location); exact stdout for each command and for edge cases (empty list, unknown id, missing args); exit codes for success and each error case. Done when every command has at least one Given/When/Then and the JSON schema is written out explicitly.

Write a black-box pytest suite in test_todo.py derived only from SPEC.md. Tests must invoke the CLI as a subprocess (`sys.executable, 'todo.py', ...`) in an isolated tmp_path working directory so no test touches the real repo's JSON file. Cover: add creates an entry and persists it; list shows added entries in the documented format; list on empty store; done marks an entry complete and it reflects in list; done on an unknown id; JSON file schema matches SPEC.md after operations. Done when the suite collects successfully and every test currently fails or errors only because todo.py does not exist yet (no implementation exists).

Write todo.py implementing the CLI exactly as specified in SPEC.md so that test_todo.py passes. Minimum code that satisfies the spec and tests; no speculative options, no config beyond what SPEC.md requires. Done when `python3 -m pytest -q test_todo.py` is fully green.
